fns.desc: When tcgetattr() fails with errno==ENOTTY, code 'goto read_pw' without ever populating 'struct termios term'; the later unconditional 'term.c_lflag |= ECHO;' reads-then-writes the still-uninitialized c_lflag field. Low real-world impact since the corrupted value is only consumed by a tcsetattr() call gated on !notty (false on this exact path), but it is a genuine read of uninitialized automatic storage.
